nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment and updated by transferOwnership.
Total supply of 1 billion YOMI tokens (1000000000e18) assigned to the owner in the YomiToken constructor.
Constant team reserve of 100000000e18 (10%) that stays locked for the team address.
Constant foundation reserve of 200000000e18 (20%) that stays locked for the foundation address.
Constant crowdsale start time 1533110400 used to derive the lock release dates.
Timestamp when the team reserve can be released (startTime + 182 days).
Timestamp when the foundation reserve can be released (startTime + 365 days).
Address of the team whose tokens are locked until lockReleaseDate6Month.
Address of the foundation whose tokens are locked until lockReleaseDate1Year.
Mapping holding the token balance of every account.
Nested mapping of owner/spender allowances used by transferFrom and approve.
Mapping marking accounts whose transfers are blocked by freezeAccount.
Constructor of Owned that assigns the deployer (msg.sender) as ownerAddr.
onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership to a new non-zero address.
Constructor of YomiToken that sets team/foundation addresses, lock dates and mints the total supply to the owner.
onlyOwner function freezing or unfreezing a target account.
Returns the total token supply.
Returns the token balance of a given owner.
Returns the remaining allowance an owner granted to a spender.
Internal transfer routine performing lock checks, freeze checks and balance updates.
Public ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer from msg.sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom deducting allowance then delegating to _transfer.
Public ERC20 approve setting the caller's allowance for a spender.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, freeze, transfer and approve operations.
Block timestamp (now) used to gate team and foundation lock release periods in _transfer.
SafeMath subtraction of transfer value from locked team/foundation balances inside _transfer lock checks.
Raw addition balances[_to] + _value used as an overflow guard inside _transfer.
SafeMath subtraction reducing the spender allowance in transferFrom.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, the address receiving ownership.
Constructor parameter _teamAddr storing the team address.
Constructor parameter _foundationAddr storing the foundation address.
Parameter _target of freezeAccount, the account to freeze or unfreeze.
Parameter _freeze of freezeAccount, the freeze flag.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf whose balance is queried.
Parameter _owner of allowance whose allowance record is queried.
Parameter _spender of allowance.
Parameter _from of _transfer, the debited account.
Parameter _to of _transfer, the credited account.
Parameter _value of _transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter _to of the public transfer function.
Parameter _value of the public transfer function.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount.
Local variable previousBalances in _transfer used for the final assertion.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns the caller msg.sender to ownerAddr.
Owned constructor writes the ownerAddr state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == ownerAddr before transferOwnership executes.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
transferOwnership updates ownerAddr with the new owner.
_teamAddr constructor parameter flows into the YomiToken constructor.
Constructor stores _teamAddr into state variable teamAddr.
_foundationAddr constructor parameter flows into the YomiToken constructor.
Constructor stores _foundationAddr into state variable foundationAddr.
startTime constant is used to compute the lock release dates.
Constructor sets lockReleaseDate6Month from startTime + 182 days.
Constructor sets lockReleaseDate1Year from startTime + 365 days.
total_supply is minted into balances[ownerAddr].
Constructor writes the balances mapping during minting.
onlyOwner modifier guards freezeAccount with the msg.sender check.
_target parameter selects which account is frozen.
_freeze parameter sets the freeze flag.
freezeAccount writes frozenAccounts[_target].
totalSupply returns the total_supply state variable.
_owner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
_owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
_from parameter flows into _transfer.
_to parameter flows into _transfer.
_value parameter flows into _transfer.
teamAddr is compared against _from to enforce the team lock.
foundationAddr is compared against _from to enforce the foundation lock.
lockReleaseDate6Month is used in the team lock check.
lockReleaseDate1Year is used in the foundation lock check.
now (block.timestamp) gates whether reserved tokens remain locked in _transfer.
_transfer reads and updates the balances mapping.
_transfer checks frozenAccounts for sender and recipient.
previousBalances local variable is computed and asserted inside _transfer.
_transfer performs SafeMath subtraction on locked balances, an unchecked arithmetic operation.
teamReserve is compared after the subtraction in the team lock check.
foundationReserve is compared after the subtraction in the foundation lock check.
_from indexes the balance used by the subtraction.
_value is the operand subtracted from the locked balance.
_transfer uses raw addition balances[_to] + _value as an overflow guard.
_transfer writes the updated balances back to the mapping.
_to parameter flows into public transfer.
_value parameter flows into public transfer.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of _transfer by transfer.
transfer calls the internal _transfer function.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into transferFrom.
msg.sender selects the spender allowance entry in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs SafeMath subtraction on the spender allowance.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer function.
_spender parameter flows into approve.
_value parameter flows into approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner set by approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only used as the argument that updates ownerAddr inside transferOwnership.
_teamAddr is only consumed by the constructor to initialize teamAddr.
_foundationAddr is only consumed by the constructor to initialize foundationAddr.
_target is only used to index frozenAccounts inside freezeAccount.
_freeze is only used as the value written into frozenAccounts.
_owner is only used to index the balances mapping in balanceOf.
_owner is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
_spender is only used to index the allowed mapping in allowance.
_from drives the lock, freeze and balance checks inside _transfer.
_to drives the zero-address and freeze checks inside _transfer.
_value is the operand of the subtraction performed by the _transfer lock arithmetic.
_to is only forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer function.
_value is only forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer function.
_from is only used to look up allowance and forwarded to _transfer.
_to is only forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom.
_value is the operand of the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
_spender is only used to index allowed[msg.sender] in approve.
_value is only written into the allowed mapping by approve.
previousBalances is a temporary sum used only by the assertion at the end of _transfer.
